relations.quote: The transform is computed over the [Polynomial ring modulo yʳ + 1](polynomial-ring.md), with $r$ a power of two, so each element is a coefficient list of length $r$.
The transform is built from the powers of $y$, and $y$ is a [Root of unity](roots-of-unity.md) of order $2r$.
The transform is computed by successive layers of [Simultaneous butterfly layer H₀](butterfly-layer.md).
